explore-mic.title: Set the mic gain
explore-mic.prompt: Turn the mic gain down until the ALC stays within its range, while keeping the peaks near full power.
hints: The ALC meter must not go past its range.
Somewhere between half and three-quarters gain.
explore-mic.success: Peaks reach full power and the ALC stays within its range. No splatter.

explore-processor.title: Speech processing
explore-processor.prompt: Raise the average power without distorting the voice.
explore-processor.success: Moderate processing doubles the average power for the same PEP. Heavy processing would distort and splatter.
